2022 Woodford Reserve Distillery Series Double Double Oaked Bourbon2022 Woodford Reserve Distillery Series Double Double Oaked Bourbon Back

The 2022 Woodford Reserve Distillery Series Double Double Oaked Straight Bourbon Whiskey is the 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), 375ml vintage released at the Versailles, Kentucky distillery at 10 a.m. on January 18, 2023 — the seventh Double Double Oaked release in the Distillery Series since 2015, and the final one credited to Master Distiller Chris Morris.

Per the series' convention, bottles carry the 2022 bottling year on the label. It was also the last vintage before the release began its march toward national availability, which arrived with the 700ml format two years later.

For collectors, this is a bookend bottle: the last Double Double Oaked of the Chris Morris era, from the annual series built, in the brand's words, on his commitment to innovation and craftsmanship.
